## 05 – Root Cause Analysis (owner: Vishwa)
Runs 02, 03, 04 → combines evidence → Groq (only if some source found evidence) → validates against `rca-output.schema.json` → stores via `POST /api/machine/investigations/:id/analysis` (**contract path, backend route not implemented: BD-2**).
The AI result is data only. Nothing here starts a remediation.
